title: One proposal of a model-design team round (one JSON object per line in the project ledger)
description: Field design adapted from microsoft/RD-Agent rdagent/core/proposal.py (Hypothesis, HypothesisFeedback, Trace; MIT). See references/multi-agent-protocol.md.

parents.description: ids this proposal builds on, plus the current best

role.description: who proposed it (analyst, structure_expert, training_expert, checker, result_analyst, human)

target_error.description: error type addressed (e.g. confident false alarms on background)

fault_checks.description: per-cell alarms summary (parity, optimizer, effective contribution, selection exposure, reload, bypass)

result.description: select-split numbers shown to the team and development numbers kept by the executor
